column3: hand-run measurement (rc44): each named re-base of the correctness pass against its baseline commit - shapes moved, gross and net mass, fallback mass before and after. Unlike the rc42 file it measures the eight NON-reference periods too, which this pass moves and the reference-year products cannot see- rc60: regenerated to record the captive year-keying re-base (net 0.000000000 Mt in every period; gross peaks at 2.98 Mt in FY2020-21; the reference year moves 0.000317 Mt).- rc62: the industrial liquids product split, measured against the same baseline as the rc60 row and published under its own name. Net 0.000000000 Mt in all nine periods; gross peaks at 0.652542 Mt in FY2015-16; the largest single provincial move is Punjab +0.295650 Mt, also FY2015-16. Punjab FALLS in FY2018-19, FY2021-22 and FY2023-24, which is the finding rather than an anomaly: the retired blend averaged furnace oil's Punjab geography together with diesel's Sindh one, so splitting them moves Punjab in whichever direction that year's liquid mix leaned.- rc62: two columns added (before_Mt_AR5, after_Mt_AR5) and one row grain. A declared provincial re-base now publishes EACH province's mass on both sides, per fiscal year, instead of only the count that moved and the largest of them - so a reader can add the five provinces up and check 'no national total moves' without re-running anything. Rows at every other grain leave the pair empty, and the fallback rows keep their own differently-named pair, because outputs/pakemis_spatial_rebase_rc42.csv shares this schema and is frozen.- rc62: --adm1-may-move now applies at every grain rather than only the nine-year provincial product. It had reached one of three checks, so a re-base whose declared purpose was to move provincial marginals was reported as breaking an invariant by the two it did not reach. The assertion the flag lifts does not vanish: it moves up to the national sum over provinces at the same grain. --modules restricts which rows are WRITTEN, never which invariants run.- rc66: the per-year provincial split of grid power (pkinv.sectors.power.province_panel), measured against rc65 with --adm1-may-move --modules power. Net 0.000000000 Mt in all nine periods; the largest provincial move is Sindh -10.52 Mt in FY2020-21 for the power module as a whole (coal alone -11.63, in outputs/pakemis_power_provincial_basis_by_year.csv); the reference year moves 0.17 Mt to Balochistan, the declared change of coal's calorific basis.
